scope: No production/test changes, tests, storefront requests, inference, installs or Git operations.

facts.fact: Current GraphQL _FIELDS selects sku/name/url_key/url_suffix/stock/description/image/price, not categories. Configurable children reuse same fields.
Current extraction GET query is fixed; variables size/page bound product pagination; repeated/missing SKU fails, budget clipping stays incomplete. Captures source response URL/time.
Legacy REST explicitly selected /rest/V1/products path captures raw items; does not issue category lookup.
Magento normalization has dedicated GraphQL helper dispatched by Magento normalizer; Product construction includes existing category_path projection.
Guarded native maintenance reuses extractor/normalizer; preserve source policy and fixed-query authorization.

Official PaaS categories query returns CategoryResult items plus pagination, supports category/parent IDs and name/path filters; omitted filters return store default root. Children are immediate subcategories, breadcrumbs describe parents.
Official example selects uid, level, name, path and children_count; nested children depth is explicit; default queryDepth is 20. SaaS does not support this PaaS categories query.

existing_reuse: MagentoGraphQLExtractor bounded fixed GET, response capture and pagination
_normalize_magento_graphql / _normalize_magento integration seam; shared normalizer remains central owner
tools.sources guarded native extraction; security policy owned centrally
Product.category_path stays legacy projection; no Product/Variant constructor or default portable contract change

proposal.term_ref: platform + taxonomy_namespace + opaque native_id with separate observation scope (supplier origin, shop/base path, optional store-view/catalog/locale)
proposal.native_id: Prefer opaque uid when explicitly observed. Retain legacy id as separately namespaced opaque string; do not base64-decode uid or equate uid/id absent explicit evidence.
proposal.membership: Unordered product memberships; never manufacture a breadcrumb by category-list order or choose deepest member as canonical.
proposal.hierarchy: Explicit parent edges or ordered ancestor paths only. Preserve level/path as supporting facts; root/store boundaries and incomplete hierarchy remain explicit.
proposal.source_state: missing/null/explicit empty/malformed distinct; graph coverage independent of product membership coverage.
proposal.mapping: Separate canonical mapping decision, rule/version and evidence refs from observed source term.
proposal.codec: Opt-in companion record, preserve strict existing portable Product format.
proposal.query: No category query implementation authorized by this artifact. Minimal product category membership field signature remains unresolved; verify before selecting fields. Shared guard owner must authorize any new fixed query and scope headers.
